name: Java Snippet Validation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'

jobs:
  validate-snippets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Java
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        java-version: '17'
        distribution: 'temurin'

    - name: Check for snippet tooling changes only
      id: changed-files
      uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v44
      with:
        files: |
          scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh
          scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh
          .github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml

    - name: Extract and validate Java snippets
      if: steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
      run: |
        # Create output directory
        mkdir -p /tmp/snippets
        
        # Extract snippets from src directory
        echo "Extracting Java snippets..."
        ./scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh CodenameOne/src > /tmp/snippets/snippets.jsonl
        
        # Count total snippets
        TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/snippets/snippets.jsonl)
        echo "Total snippets extracted: $TOTAL"
        
        # Validate each snippet
        echo "Validating snippets..."
        VALIDATION_ERRORS=0
        while IFS= read -r line; do
          if [ -z "$line" ]; then continue; fi
          
          # Extract fields from JSONL record
          SOURCE_FILE=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.sourceFile')
          SYMBOL=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.symbol')
          SNIPPET_INDEX=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.snippetIndex')
          START_LINE=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.startLine')
          END_LINE=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.endLine')
          CODE=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.code')
          
          # Validate snippet using playground harness
          RESULT=$(
            echo "$CODE" | \
            ./scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh 2>&1 || true
          )
          
          # Check if validation failed
          if [[ "$RESULT" == *"EVAL_ERROR"* ]] || [[ "$RESULT" == *"COMPILATION_ERROR"* ]]; then
            echo "❌ Validation failed for snippet: $SOURCE_FILE#$SYMBOL (index: $SNIPPET_INDEX, lines $START_LINE-$END_LINE)"
            echo "   Error: $RESULT"
            VALIDATION_ERRORS=$((VALIDATION_ERRORS + 1))
          elif [[ "$RESULT" == *"ERROR"* ]]; then
            echo "⚠️  Validation error for snippet: $SOURCE_FILE#$SYMBOL (index: $SNIPPET_INDEX, lines $START_LINE-$END_LINE)"
            echo "   Error: $RESULT"
          else
            echo "✅ Validated snippet: $SOURCE_FILE#$SYMBOL (index: $SNIPPET_INDEX, lines $START_LINE-$END_LINE)"
          fi
        done < /tmp/snippets/snippets.jsonl
        
        # Fail if any validation errors occurred
        if [ "$VALIDATION_ERRORS" -gt 0 ]; then
          echo "❌ Found $VALIDATION_ERRORS validation errors"
          exit 1
        else
          echo "✅ All snippets validated successfully"
        fi
